cohort: The study included primiparous women with singleton term deliveries in Sweden between 2014-2020, comparing those born in FGM-practicing countries with Swedish-born women.
finding: Primiparous women from FGM-practicing countries had a significantly increased risk of emergency cesarean section compared to Swedish-born women, but a confirmed FGM diagnosis itself did not significantly contribute to this risk.
mod_finding: Primiparous women from FGM-practicing countries had an increased risk of emergency cesarean section compared to Swedish-born women, which was the primary outcome related to mode of birth.
